lrw.text: Brigid Baeli, an archer of Kinsbaile, is assigned by Gaddock Teeg to accompany Ashling in finding the Gilt-Leaf elf Rhys, and then ordered to capture Rhys as a gift for the commander Nath.

A forged message from Colfenor turns her against the wrong people, so she nearly drowns Ashling and attacks Rhys at the Murmuring Bosk, and Colfenor later admits he ordered it to coincide with his rebirth.
Filled with self-reproach, Brigid leaves Kinsbaile to atone, and she works as a decoy to free Brion and Kiel from Gilt-Leaf hunters.
She later takes the Crescent of Morningtide as the Great Aurora sweeps the world and survives the shift into Shadowmoor intact.

shm.text: In Shadowmoor, Brigid lives in Mistmeadow, where her brigade helps limit the damage when Ashling the Destroyer attacks, and she gives Jack her magical wingbow after saving him from Sygg.
Brigid, Maralen, Captain Sygg and the Source of the Wanderbrine subdue the Destroyer, and Maralen gains the elemental power instead of Oona, who retreats to Cayr Ulios and drains the elves.
Maralen betrays Sygg and keeps the Crescent after the ambush on Ashling.

eve.text: In Eventide, Maralen is revealed to be Oona's twin and defies her, taking the Crescent of Morningtide from Brigid Baeli.
Oona is then defeated by Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor's sapling, though her consciousness survives.
